notes.title: v1.12
notes.content:
Highlights

 Endless Mode received changes, see below.
 Cards now play their draw animation when added to your hand through random effects. (e.g: Harvest Knowledge)


Endless Mode changes
Previous to this patch, the difficulty in Endless Mode scaled linearly, which made it easy to become practically invincible and keep playing infinitely with enemies dying almost instantly. Also, being able to stack trinkets infinitely made it a certainty that at some point, all players will experience performance issues, to the point of the game crashing when playing for too long.
To address these issues, this patch implements the following changes:


 The Eternal Bane and Eternal Sorrow trinkets have been removed from the game. That means that elites will give trinkets again, and player heal effects will no longer have a chance to fail.
 The difficulty in Endless Mode now scales exponentially.
 Enemies now also grow their speed and their resistances against stuns, slows, and teleports on each loop (the maximum enemy speed has been set to 250)
 The trinket limit is now 100. After obtaining 100 trinkets, the following trinkets you would gain disappear on pickup and give you a random stat boost instead. Whenever you have 90 trinkets or more and you hover over a trinket, a small text message appears indicating the number of trinkets you have and the limit.
 After the fifth loop, effects that deal damage based on the amount of health/max health enemies have can deal a maximum of 9999 damage.
 A new Endless Mode indicator has been added to the top bar, that explains the current difficulty modifiers when hovered.
 Additional changes might come in future patches such as limiting the game speed when the FPS drops too low while playing in a high endless loop. Reducing the game speed and enabling Low Performance Mode really help if you're experiencing performance issues!

https://i.imgur.com/19proH4.png

notes.content:
Hi everyone! Small patch today, bringing a requested change by increasing maximum game speed a bit, and some changes to improve performance in long survival runs! (in the Celestial Dawn DLC)

Highlights

 The maximum game speed is now x4 instead of x3.


[Celestial Dawn DLC] Survival Mode Difficulty Scalings
Up until this patch, the way difficulty increased while playing survival was by steadily ramping up the number of spawned enemies as time progressed, especially after minute 18, since up until that point the scaling is mainly done through the enemies leveling up. 

In hindsight, I now see that was a mistake. The reasons are obvious, an infinitely scaling game mode with an infinitely increasing number of enemies spawning means worse performance as minutes go on, until the game can't handle that many enemies anymore and crashes. Rookie mistake, but let's fix that!

From this patch onwards the amount of enemies still increases over time, but once it reaches a limit (about 30-40 enemies at the same time on the screen, depending on the map), incoming enemy flow stabilizes and the scaling is now done mainly by increasing their health and resistances.

This change should drastically improve performance on deep, long survival games. I believe that it should no longer crash, no matter how long the game lasts.

Balance changes
Regarding attrition
Health attrition works differently in Tower Tactics: Liberation compared to other roguelike deckbuilders. In this game, it's very easy to recover health during combats, so hunting as most elites as possible is usually the best strategy, as it usually doesn't have many negative consequences. 
With the new Shields mechanic, we open up a lot of new design space, and making health regeneration effects rarer and a bit more costly will make them feel more special and will make each decision the player makes matter more.

notes.content:

 HUGE UPDATE! 45 trinkets have been added to the game, and now all events have their own unique illustration! You'll notice these upgrades ingame for sure! (All event illustrations were made using DALL-E 2 by OpenAI).

 Eternal Bane now reads: This trinket can't be removed. Enemies have 200% more health and 50% more resistances. Elites give no trinkets. The scaling is now +200% health and +50% resistances each loop.

The scaling is now +10% player heal fail chance (up to 95%), half the card count threshold (down to a minimum of 1) and +1 enemy damage each loop.

notes.title: early access 1.10
notes.content:
Highlights

 A French translation has been added to the game thanks to @arialdead!
 8 new cards! Say hello to Life Absorber, Guardian Angel, Runic Extractor, Blood Visions, Sweet Vengeance, Self Wound, Mystery Boost and Barricade! Check them out in the card list!
 2 new maps!
 1 new event!
 1 new enemy, the EMP Bomb! Be careful, it might disrupt your defenses!
 Now the enemies have a subtle shaking animation when they receive damage.

 Wandering Colossus

 Holy Guild

 Starting mana: 1 -> 2

 Everchanging

 Ace in the Hole

notes.content:

 Trinket list: You can now view all trinkets in the game, categorized by rarity!

 Starting luck: 2 -> 3

notes.title: early access 1.8
notes.content:

Towers

notes.title: early access 1.7.2
notes.content:
Just in time for 2022! Happy new year everyone!

Highlights

 If you have basic cards in your deck, there's a 50% chance when entering a shop for the "60 crystals: Remove a card from your deck" button to be replaced with "40 crystals: Convert a random basic card into its non-basic version."
 New text was added to make selling towers and canceling card casts easier to notice.
 Events from which you can take advantage of Holy Mantle now show a glow effect! (only if you haven't used all of it).
 Text panels in the tutorial are now more opaque to make them easier to read from.
 The crystals number in the top left corner now has an animation when you gain or lose crystals.
 BUG FIX: Tower outlines should now always work properly when hovering.
 BUG FIX: The background should no longer stutter randomly (happened in rare occasions)
 BUG FIX: War Totem no longer has a chance to spawn another level 3 tower.
 BUG FIX: Trinkets that care about having received damage in a combat no longer lose their effect in the event that deals 2 damage and starts an elite fight.
 BUG FIX: The correct amount of mana will now be earned in the round after selling a Beam Cannon.

notes.title: early access 1.7.1
notes.content:
Highlights

 The trinkets each deck has will now appear in the Deck view in the main menu!
 There is now a help popup on each deck giving small tips on how to play them!
 Now a random background is selected everytime the game boots.

notes.title: early access 1.7
notes.content:
Highlights

 3 new towers! You can now find Earthquake, Inhibitor and Scrap Recycler in your adventures.
 A card list has been added to the Stats menu.
 Reduced the diminishing returns stuns and slows have by a bit. Decks that aim to permalock enemies in place should be more viable now. In addition to this, enemies can only regen for a set amount of time, so there should no longer be situations where an enemy is permalocked in place and regens more health than the damage you can deal.
 Some really needed clarity improvements, balance changes and bug fixes. More details below.


Clarity improvements

 The information shown when hovering tower cards has been expanded to show stun durations, slow strength, health based damage, and more!
 Trick room now has an animation when shooting. The color of the animation indicates the effect the tower is going to make.
 Isochron Bot now shows the amount of spells casted.
 Arcane Resonator now shows the spell that it's going to copy and the amount of times it has copied it.


Balance changes
Towers

 Downshaper

 Mana cost: 3 -> 4
 Range: (300, 320, 340) -> (350, 375, 400)
 Fire rate: (0.08, 0.24, 0.72) -> (0.12, 0.28, 0.63)


Spells

 Fireball: Deal 60 + 15% enemy missing health magic damage. -> Deal 90 + 20% enemy missing health magic damage.
 Mortar Strike: Deal 120 + 25% enemy current health physical damage. -> Deal 150 + 25% enemy current health physical damage


Bug fixes

 The Deprived Soul deck can now make use of all events.
 Map nodes in Sector 3 will no longer sometimes be placed too close to each other.
 Responsiveness when hovering placed towers should be much better now.
 You can no longer click the "Continue" button beneath the Card Reward popup.
 The Isochron Bot is now correctly buffed when the Arcane Resonator copies a spell.

notes.title: early access 1.6
notes.content:
Highlights

 Final bosses! The last wave of the last sector's boss will have a special enemy, be prepared! There are 3 different final bosses as of now. The final boss you'll face is revealed in the sector map, to give you time to prepare against it. The final bosses are also included in the Bestiary.
 Now the amount of nodes of a certain type in each sector map is balanced. This ensures that each sector map will have 2-4 elites, 1-2 shops and 1-3 bonfires (in sectors 1 and 2) and 3-5 elites (in sector 3)
 Approximately half of the maps have been adjusted to make them fairer for the player.
 Now you'll get 1 EXP for each 2 crystals you have at the end of a run.
 1 new spell! (All for One)
 Some small visual enhancements, balance changes and bug fixes. More details below.


Balance changes
Trinkets

 Crystal Ore: 6 crystals for each hit -> 10 crystals for each hit.

Towers

 Ruthless End: Fire rate (1, 1.1, 1.2) -> (0.9, 1.1, 1.3)

Mythic Offerings

 Max Health: 2 -> 3
 Armor penetration: 15 -> 18
 Magic penetration: 15 -> 18


QoL updates and bug fixes

 Now the tower stats have a fade animation.
 Now the enemy health bar is shown below the enemy to make it easier to see.
 BUG FIX: Now the trinket descriptions show above the map.
 BUG FIX: Now the menu buttons can't be clicked when certain popups were opened in the main menu.

notes.title: early access 1.5.1
notes.content:
Highlights


 Some fixes to the color palette of offerings to make them more colorblind friendly
 Some fixes to the german translation thanks to @Nariel
 A new set of buttons in the bottom of the ascension select menu that help visualize the progress made with each deck.
 The possibility of unlocking further ascensions without the need to play them for 200 astral dust.
 The "Air Support" enchantment now costs 6 mana instead of 7.

notes.title: early access 1.5
notes.content:
The beauty update!
This patch focuses mainly in improving the visual design of some crucial aspects of the game. Your eyes will appreciate it! (we hope so, at least)


 All cards now have a new design! Check them out, you'll notice the difference!
 The event options have been redesigned to be more readable!
 New background variations! it'll no longer be the same background every time! There are now 81 different backgrounds for each sector (up from 1)

notes.title: early access 1.4
notes.content:
Highlights

 There is now a bestiary! Check it out in the Stats menu!
 German translation!: This translation is in beta stage and may contain errors. As always, if you spot any let me know and they'll get fixed ASAP!
 Now much more EXP is awarded when runs are won fast. The bonus EXP scales as the game time gets reduced, going from 20 EXP for 50 mins or less up to 700 EXP for 10 mins or less.
 There is now an extra incentive to join the Official Discord server! Join through the in-game menu and win 1000 astral dust!
 3 new cards! Decimate the Weak, Dark Reckoning and Downshaper. Try them out!
 The game is now approximately 20% faster! All enemies have now approximately 20% more speed, and all towers have been rebalanced according to this so the difficulty doesn't change.
 The game has been updated to use Godot 3.4!
 Many small QoL updates (also detailed below).


QoL updates and bug fixes

 There's now a button to delete all progress. If you wanted to start again from scratch, now you can!
 Now the Map and Deck screens have a close button (You can also close them by clicking the top menu icons as before).
 BUG FIX: Now the Reroll and Retain hand buttons are less transparent to make them easier to spot.
 BUG FIX: Now the next available map nodes upon advancing to a new Sector play their animation correctly.
 BUG FIX: Now the Early Bird deck starts with the correct trinket.

notes.title: early access 1.3.1
notes.content:
Each boss now has their on music theme! Give them a listen!
 Fixed many errors in the Brazilian Portuguese translation thanks to Foxmaiden!
 Now a confirm popup appears when clicking the restart button to avoid misclicks.
 Now the Holy Guild deck starts with a new trinket that increases maximum overload by 1.
 Now the maximum spell mana is displayed next to the current spell mana.
 Fixed a typo in the english translation of the Yellow Feathers trinket
 Reduced the game's size by about 30MB. (The previous patch also reduced it by like 90MB!). This is thanks to using more suitable audio formats for the background music.

notes.title: early access 1.3
notes.content:
Another huge patch full of goodies!

Highlights

 16 new trinkets! This is a 34% increase, considering we had 47 before!
 Brazilian Portuguese translation!: This translation is in beta stage and may contain errors. As always, if you spot any let me know and they'll get fixed ASAP!
 Complete music revamp! Many new background tracks that complement the old ones creating a much better gameplay experience. I sincerely recommend playing with the music on.
 Astral Dust progression mini-rework (details below).
 Many small QoL updates (also detailed below).


Astral Dust and offering changes
These changes aim to reduce the need to disenchant offerings to create new ones, among many other things.

 The Astral Dust gained for completing a sector has gone up approximately 50%! (when the player's level is low the buff is even stronger, closer to +100%)
 Common offerings now cost 100 astral dust to enchant, instead of 200.
 The buff to the astral dust you get when disenchanting offerings obtained at levels 7, 14, 21 and 28 increased from +25% each to +100% each
 The base astral dust you get for disenchanting offerings has changed to the following (remember that when you reach high levels, you get more astral dust than before due to the other changes in this patch):

 Common: 40 -> 20
 Uncommon: 80 -> 60
 Rare: 160 -> 120
 Mythic: 480 -> 360

 Now there is a common max health offering.
 The mythic health regen offering now gives 2 regen instead of 1.
 The astral dust earned when you cannot receive a new offering because all the slots are full has increased from 40 to 200.


Deck balance
Leading Legacy

 Max health: 12 -> 14
 Range & attack speed multipliers: 6% -> 9%
 Flat armor & magic pen: 6 -> 0

Wandering Colossus

 Max health: 15 -> 17

Resonating Echoes

 Flat magic pen: 5 -> 15

Early Bird

 Flat armor & magic pen: 12 -> 24


QoL improvements and other changes

 Maps now have backgrounds
 Improved the damage number animations (it makes a bigger difference than you might think)
 Ascension indicator in the top bar ingame
 Now the game remembers which ascension you last selected in each deck
 The boss modifier that disabled the first tower you placed has been removed
 Removed the early wave types that had Hijackers (so you'll start to face them in later waves)

notes.title: early access 1.2.2
notes.content:
Some more bug fixes!

 BUG FIX: Blurry text when zooming cards.
 BUG FIX: Cards on top of each other when having too many in hand.
 BUG FIX: Not being able to select some resolutions that should be valid in windowed mode.
 BUG FIX: When in fullscreen mode, the resolution text doesn't display the correct resolution. (Although the game is displayed in the correct resolution, it's a visual bug)
 BUG FIX: The window wasn't being centered in the screen when booting up the game in some situations.


And some fixes in the polish translation thanks to bron99!

notes.title: early access 1.2.1
notes.content:
Some small bug fixes to ensure the best gameplay experience.


 BUG FIX: Now win streaks are calculated properly.
 BUG FIX: Now the hijacker and tower level-up tutorials should display properly on 4K screens.
 BUG FIX: Now you can remove and duplicate cards in the shop when having the exact crystals required.
 BUG FIX: The deck and map screens are now completely opaque. Now the reward screen shouldn't be seen through them.
 BUG FIX: Cards no longer show altered combat stats after the combat ends, nor in the deck list in the main menu.

notes.title: early access 1.2
notes.content:
You thought last patch was big? Brace yourselves.

Highlights

 Portuguese and Polish translations: These translations are in beta stage and may contain errors. As always, if you spot any let me know and they'll get fixed ASAP!
 Many more wave types with more enemy quantity! As of last patch, the average enemy count in each wave was 3.4, and now it's 4.05. Various towers that dealt AoE damage have been balanced in result.
 Two new maps!
 Two new boss trinkets! (Fairy Wand and Sweet Candy)
 You can now change the game speed with hotkeys! (a tooltip with all the existing hotkeys is coming in the future)

 H: Set game speed to x0.
 J: Reduce game speed by x0.5.
 K: Increase game speed by x0.5.
 L: Set game speed to x2.5.

 Crit chance now scales with luck for all towers! 1 luck equals 0.33% crit chance.
 Towers that are already placed now have tooltips explaining what they do.
 The EXP gained by completing levels and obtaining trinkets has gone up 50%!


Balance changes
Trinkets
Most of the boss trinkets have been changed to make the decision to pick one or another more interesting.

 Ancient Knowledge: Starting mana 2 -> 3
 Bookworm: Draw one more card each round. Reduce in 1 the maximum overload. -> Draw one more card each round. Lose 6 luck.
 Golden Catalyst: Gold multiplier -75% -> -90%
 Heart Catalyst: Max health lost 4 -> 3
 Spell Elixir: Spell mana 2 -> 3


Cards

 Freezing Fog: Range 55 -> 65, Slow duration 4 -> 3
 Rebound Shock: Starting magic damage 20 -> 30, Scaling multiplier 10% -> 7.5%
 Arcane resonator: Range (155, 155, 155) -> (170, 170, 170), Fire rate (0.08, 0.24, 0.72) -> (0.12, 0.36, 1.08). Now the tower's fire rate is reduced when it casts many copies of the same spell, up to -90% when copying 12+.
 BF Rifle: Range (130, 140, 150) -> (125, 135, 145)
 Ballista: Range (125, 135, 145) -> (120, 135, 150), Fire rate (1, 1.5, 2) -> (0.8, 1.2, 1.6). Now pierces all enemies since level 1.
 Basic Bomber: Fire rate (0.5, 0.72, 0.94) -> (0.45, 0.65, 0.85), Range (95, 115, 135) -> (95, 110, 125). Taking into account the increased average enemy count, this tower's power level is roughly the same.
 Bomber: Fire rate (0.5, 0.75, 1) -> (0.5, 0.7, 0.9), Range (95, 115, 135) -> (95, 110, 125). Same as the Basic Bomber.
 Cremator: Range (150, 150, 150) -> (155, 155, 155), Fire rate (3.5, 4, 4.5) -> (2.8, 3.2, 3.6). 
 Disruptor: Range (100, 120, 140) -> (110, 120, 130), Fire rate (1.4, 1.5, 1.6) -> (1.75, 2, 2.25), Magic damage (2, 6, 18) -> (1, 3, 9)
 Fulminator: Fire rate (0.24, 0.25, 0.26) -> (0.25, 0.27, 0.29)
 Giant's Bane: Range (130, 140, 150) -> (150, 150, 150)
 Isochron Bot: Range (90, 90, 90) -> (95, 95, 95), Fire rate (0.65, 0.65, 0.65) -> (0.75, 0.75, 0.75)
 Ruthless End: Magic pen (100, 100, 100) -> (400, 400, 400)
 Sniper: Fire rate (0.3, 0.45, 0.6) -> (0.3, 0.4, 0.5)
 Virtuoso: Range (110, 115, 120) -> (120, 125, 130)


Bug Fixes

 Spell mana is no longer spent when casting spells that have reduced costs.
 Towers and enemies shouldn't randomly lose mouse focus now.
 The Everchanging deck now correctly shows ascension progress in the deck list.

notes.title: early access 1.1
notes.content:
The first patch of the game after the Early Access release! And this is a big one.

Highlights

 Spell mana: A new mechanic that allows players to cast spells using a special kind of mana that doesn't recharge between rounds. All decks start with 1 spell mana.
 Chinese and Russian translations. These translations may not be perfect, so if you spot any errors just hit me up and they'll get fixed in no time!
 New maximum game speed (x2.5) and minimum (x0).
 Small buff to the experience and astral dust gained. Approximately 5% more exp and 40% more astral dust (decreasing to 10% as the player levels up) is gained now.
 3 new trinkets!
 Rebalanced the health damage of some event options to make them less unfair.
 New tooltips explaining the damage count after each round and the leveling up of towers.

notes.title: Official discord server is up!

Discord link

notes.title: Ready for take-off! (early access 1.0)
notes.content:

notes.title: early access 0.5

 Sanctuary explanation
 Changing decks

 Laser Rifle

notes.content:

Decks

Berserker
